sankey.comment: Read sankey with an optional case-insensitive -beta suffix and a word boundary before the record context. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and sankey.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Track the three fields of each record, retaining that position across multiline strings. Follows sankey.md#diagram-and-records and sankey.md#ids-and-values.
After the first comma, read the target and then the value field. Follows sankey.md#diagram-and-records.
After the second comma, read the link value rather than an element name. Follows sankey.md#ids-and-values.

sankey-html-tag.comment: Read shared HTML tag parts; paired quotes crossing the tag end or a common comment remain available to the surrounding CSV string. Follows common.md#html-attribute-quotes, sankey.md#strings, common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary, and common.md#comment-lines.

sankey-string.comment: Read CSV quoted strings with doubled quotes and multiline content. Follows sankey.md#strings.

patterns.comment: Read quoted content while leaving common-comment boundaries to the enclosing context. Follows sankey.md#strings and common.md#comment-lines.
Read shared HTML parts while protecting doubled quotes. Follows sankey.md#lexical-structure.

patterns.name: constant.character.escape.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read doubled quotes as a string escape, including directives between their characters. Follows sankey.md#strings and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

sankey-name.comment: Read an unquoted source or target id as an element name, retaining authored HTML quote text inside the field. Follows sankey.md#ids-and-values, sankey.md#the-record-context, and common.md#comment-lines.

sankey-value.comment: Display a whole unquoted integer or decimal value as a number for the reader, although the document reads any value as text. Other unquoted values retain their text scope. Follows sankey.md#ids-and-values and common.md#comment-lines.

patterns.comment: Display a whole integer or decimal value with optional surrounding spaces as a number, leaving the padding outside the number scope. Follows sankey.md#ids-and-values and common.md#comment-lines.
Read other unquoted link values as text, keeping directives independent. Follows sankey.md#ids-and-values and common.md#comment-lines.
